purpose: Preserve control-migration questions whose resolution may depend on research/governance semantics without allowing CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE to self-grant task-publication, Driver, Steward, theorem-review, or Foundation authority. These requests are not scheduler/runtime tasks. An authorized Researcher/Driver/Steward may later publish a real immutable GOVERNANCE task if the request still requires investigation.

requests.question: Can the six V1 task-publication control pointers be migrated to immutable V2 authority without changing any mathematical/research governance semantics carried by research_architecture.json?
required_verification: Enumerate the exact six JSON pointers and their V2 replacements. CONTROL structural evidence now supplies this mechanically.

Prove or explicitly justify that FREE discovery substrate/anti-anchoring semantics are unchanged. CONTROL structural evidence proves the corresponding JSON blocks are byte/structure-equivalent outside the six target pointers; authorized governance review must still classify the six pointer meanings.
Prove or explicitly justify that Working Truth activation/falsifier semantics are unchanged. CONTROL structural evidence pins the unchanged block; authorized governance review remains required.
Prove or explicitly justify that axiom-candidate lifecycle and origin provenance are unchanged. CONTROL structural evidence pins the unchanged block; authorized governance review remains required.

Prove or explicitly justify that successor-stage, portfolio-balance, and route-closure semantics are unchanged. CONTROL structural evidence pins the unchanged blocks; authorized governance review remains required.

Prove or explicitly justify that Foundation backflow, independence/replication, promotion, and theorem-status semantics are unchanged. CONTROL structural evidence pins the unchanged blocks; authorized governance review remains required.
Produce an exact field-local proposed diff; no unrelated JSON pointer may change. CONTROL structural checker provides the field-local proposal but does not authorize writing it.
forbidden_shortcuts: treating newer control precedence as proof that older mathematical/governance text is semantically irrelevant
changing wording or values outside the six registered pointers while performing the cutover
treating the CONTROL structural-evidence checker as Foundation Steward or Research Driver approval
